synthesisReport.summary: The hypothesis that security specialists and IT executives from the corporate sector are concerned about data leaks when using LLM at work is supported by comments in professional communities. Many users express fear of data leaks and fines, and some have encountered such incidents. However, there is a lack of willingness to participate in anonymous surveys, and some users are skeptical about the purpose of the survey. The target audience is ready to discuss security issues in professional channels to stay aware of threats and solutions.
recommendations: Consider a minimal MVP focused on providing a secure LLM solution for SMB HR agencies, given the demand for data leak prevention and the willingness to discuss security issues.
Develop a survey that addresses the concerns of the target audience, such as data leak prevention and fines, and offer to share the results with participants to increase willingness to participate.

Pivot the product idea to focus on providing a secure LLM solution for SMB HR agencies, given the lack of willingness to participate in anonymous surveys and the skepticism about the purpose of the survey.

projectName: PII Guardian for SMB HR Agencies
projectHypothesis: If we post in professional communities (LinkedIn InfoSec groups, Telegram channels for CISO, SecurityStack forums and Reddit r/cybersecurity) with a call to take an anonymous survey (3 questions) about real incidents or concerns related to data leaks when using LLM at work, and offer to share the survey results with all participants, then within 72 hours at least 30 security specialists and IT executives from the corporate sector will fill out the questionnaire, and at least 50% of them will confirm that they have encountered leaks or seriously fear such risks, because companies are actively looking for ways to prevent leaks and fines, and the target audience is ready to discuss security issues in professional channels to stay aware of threats and solutions.

assumptionAssessments.evidence: Of 111 comments, ~61 match the topic of this assumption, indicating that companies really suffer from data leaks when using LLM or are very afraid of such risks.
Of 111 comments, ~48 match the topic of this assumption, suggesting that people who deal with security in companies are aware of this problem and are looking for its solution.

While ~53 comments match the topic of this assumption, there is limited evidence to confirm that these people are actively reading professional forums and willing to spend time filling out surveys from strangers.
Although ~73 comments match the topic of this assumption, there is no direct evidence to confirm that we will be able to create a product that solves this problem better than existing options.
Of 111 comments, ~50 match the topic of this assumption, but there is limited evidence to confirm that these people are willing to communicate further with us to learn about a possible solution.
